title: Kicky Korean Red Pepper Bowl
description: A fresh and spicy Korean-inspired dish made with red pepper paste, served in a traditional Korean brass bowl. This quick-fix recipe is perfect for those looking for a no-onion-no-garlic-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the red pepper paste and water until smooth.
In a large skillet, heat the red pepper paste mixture over medium heat.
Add the cubed tofu to the skillet and cook until golden brown on all sides.
In a separate pot, heat the cooked white rice over low heat.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of the heated rice into the bottom of a Korean brass bowl.
Add a layer of mixed greens on top of the rice.
Place the cooked tofu on top of the greens.
Drizzle the remaining red pepper paste mixture over the tofu.
Sprinkle the roasted sesame seeds, salt, and black pepper over the top.
